description.en: Three paper cards pair woodblock landscapes with real perforated edges, spring tilt and a pointer-following sheen.
description.zh: 三张纸质卡片搭配木刻风景，保留透明齿孔、弹簧倾斜和跟随指针的纸面高光。

keywords: 邮票 齿孔 卡片 纸张 木刻 浮世绘 插画 弹簧 倾斜 高光 perforated stamp cards paper woodblock illustration mask spring tilt devxnuj

useCases: 带真实邮票齿孔与纸面弹簧倾斜的三张介绍卡
Three illustrated paper cards with transparent perforations and spring hover feedback
discovery.caveat: 卡片用于展示内容，未添加虚构业务操作；原HTML与插画许可未核实，Inter保留OFL许可。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML and three illustrations adapted to an instance-scoped DOM/SVG core with six native framework entries and an existing licensed Inter subset. Cards remain informational articles with focus and hover feedback.
source.license: No separate license was supplied or verified for the HTML or illustrations. The embedded Inter subset retains its SIL Open Font License notice.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Hover or focus a card to tilt the paper and move its sheen. Cards stack vertically on narrow screens.
instructions.zh: 悬停或聚焦卡片，可看到纸张倾斜与高光变化。窄屏下三张卡片纵向排列。
